in a recipe, used for transforming selected columns of a DataFrame.
StepImputeFill: Imputes missing values using a specified value or strategy (e.g., forward fill, backward fill).
StepImputeFastZeroFill: Quickly imputes missing values with 0 for grouped DataFrames.
StepImputeFastForwardFill: Quickly imputes missing values using forward fill for grouped DataFrames.
StepImputeModel: Uses a pretrained imputation model to fill missing values.
StepHistorical: Generates columns with historical accumulations (e.g., max, min, mean).
StepSklearn: Wraps a scikit-learn transformer to use it as a step in a recipe.
StepResampling: Resamples data to a new resolution using specified accumulators.
StepScale: Scales data using scikit-learn's StandardScaler.
StepFunction: Wraps a simple transformation function without requiring fitting." style="text;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=11;fontColor=default;labelBackgroundColor=default;" div.div:
Step: Represents a generic step in a recipe, used for transforming selected columns of a DataFrame.
StepImputeFill: Imputes missing values using a specified value or strategy (e.g., forward fill, backward fill).
StepImputeFastZeroFill: Quickly imputes missing values with 0 for grouped DataFrames.
StepImputeFastForwardFill: Quickly imputes missing values using forward fill for grouped DataFrames.
StepImputeModel: Uses a pretrained imputation model to fill missing values.
StepHistorical: Generates columns with historical accumulations (e.g., max, min, mean).
StepSklearn: Wraps a scikit-learn transformer to use it as a step in a recipe.
StepResampling: Resamples data to a new resolution using specified accumulators.
StepScale: Scales data using scikit-learn's StandardScaler.
StepFunction: Wraps a simple transformation function without requiring fitting.

div.div:
all_of: Selects columns with specific names.
regex_names: Selects columns where the name matches a regex pattern.
starts_with: Selects columns where the name starts with a specific prefix.
ends_with: Selects columns where the name ends with a specific suffix.
contains: Selects columns where the name contains a specific substring.
has_role: Selects columns with specific roles.
has_type: Selects columns with specific data types.
all_predictors: Selects all predictor columns.
all_numeric_predictors: Selects all numeric predictor columns.
all_outcomes: Selects all outcome columns.
all_groups: Selects all grouping variables.
select_groups: Directly selects grouping columns.
all_sequences: Selects all sequence variables.
select_sequence: Directly selects sequence columns.
